title.narrative: Media in Libya: Immune against Disinformation

description.narrative: The actions overall objective (OO) is to provide Libyans with improved access to independent and accurate information since well-informed citizens are an indispensable prerequisite for any form of peaceful democratic transition and conflict prevention. The specific objective aims at strenghtening Libyan media professionals (journalists, fact-checkers and influencers) and international political decision makers.
